generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of lakeside wetland (湖边湿地). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a tranquil freshwater wetland from the start of a wooden boardwalk, using the rails as leading lines toward a small birdwatching hide. A single grey heron stands in shallow water and one green frog rests on the nearest board, both anatomically correct and separated. Group the reed bed and one tall cattail on opposite sides, with a water lily and a distinct patch of duckweed on the open water. Mount one nesting box on a waterside post in the upper third. Misty early-morning light, gentle reflections and open negative space; no flocks or duplicated wildlife.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: freshwater lake, reed bed, water lily, wooden boardwalk, birdwatching hide, grey heron, green frog, cattail, floating duckweed, waterside nesting box.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
